title: Arnoldi-Enhanced Multivariate Hermite Interpolation of Manifold-Valued Data
summary: This paper integrates the multivariate Arnoldi process into tangent space Hermite interpolation for manifold-valued data. A G-Arnoldi recurrence constructs a discrete orthogonal polynomial basis, improving numerical conditioning for high-degree approximation. The analysis uses a Markov inequality with a geometry-dependent exponent r; for the convex parameter domains considered here, r = 2 is available.
